excerpts.text: Zaahen's attacks and abilities against enemy champions grant him stacks of Determination, gaining bonus Attack Damage per stack. When filled with Determination, Zaahen gains increased Attack Damage and can revive.

Cultivation of War
Static Cooldown:
300 / 240 / 180 / 120 (based on level)
Innate: Zaahen's basic attacks and abilities against enemy champions grant him stacks of Determination, refreshing on subsequent damage to champions and stacking up to 12 times. Periodically, if Zaahen would take lethal damage while at maximum stacks of Determination, he will enter resurrection for a short time, healing himself over the duration and then reviving himself. Determination: For each stack, Zaahen gains bonus attack damage, increased greatly while at maximum stacks.
Innate: Zaahen generates a stack of Determination for each enemy champion damaged by his basic attacks and abilities, lasting for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent triggers, and stacking up to 12 times. After the duration, the stacks expire by 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 (based on seconds elapsed) every 0.5 seconds.
Determination: For each stack, Zaahen gains bonus attack damage equal to 1.5% – 2.95% (based on level) AD. At maximum stacks, Zaahen becomes filled with Determination, causing him to double the bonus to 36% – 70.87% (based on level) AD.Periodically, if Zaahen would take lethal damage while at maximum stacks of Determination, he refreshes its duration and enters resurrection for 4 seconds: becoming invulnerable, untargetable, and unable to act. Additionally, he restores「 30% / 45% / 60% / 75% (based on level) of his maximum health 」「 0.94% / 1.41% / 1.88% / 2.34% (based on level) of his maximum health every 0.125 seconds 」over the duration. Afterwards, he revives himself and refreshes the duration of Determination.

The bonus attack damage granted by Determination stacks will update dynamically with Zaahen's total attack damage.
Determination stacks are generated per damage instance per champion damaged with Zaahen's attacks and abilities.
The Darkin Glaive's initial cast empowered attack can generate a stack for each strike.
Both passes of Dreaded Return can generate a stack.
Both Aureate Rush's swing and Grim Deliverance's shockwave generate a stack for every champion hit.
Ivern's Triggerseed generates a stack for every champion hit when cast on Zaahen.(bug)
During the resurrection's health restoration, Zaahen's current health is set to a percentage of his maximum health equal to the cumulative amount of health restored on that restoration tick, for every single tick.
In other words, his current health will always be overridden by the percentage of health he is supposed to have restored on every restoration tick, to prevent him from healing or restoring health by other sources.
Upon the resurrection being triggered, all summoner spells that are not already on cooldown are placed on a 5-second cooldown.
The untargetability from the resurrection does not destroy in-flight projectiles.
Cultivation of War's resurrection takes priority over Guardian Angel's Rebirth, but grants priority to Zilean's Chronoshift.
The resurrection does not activate if Zaahen is killed by the Nexus Obelisk.
Invulnerability will prevent stacks from being generated, as no damage is dealt.
Spell shield will not prevent stacks from being generated, even if no damage is dealt.(bug)
Cultivation of War stacks additively with Infernal Might and Overlord's Bloodmail's Retribution and multiplicatively with mid lane quest's bonus AD multiplier.
Determination stacks are displayed in a secondary resource bar under Zaahen's health bar.
The bar is white at <4 stacks, yellow at ≥4 stacks and orange at ≥9 stacks.
At maximum stacks, if the revive is available, the bar will be red and will remain red after Zaahen revives until he loses stacks again.(unexpected)
There's a short delay between the stacks falling off and the removal of the revive. If Zaahen triggers it during this time, it will fail to go on cooldown.(bug)

The Darkin Glaive's damage is tagged as basic damage and spell damage, which allows it to trigger spell effects.
Spell shield will only block the knock up from the recast.
Since the healing is granted on-attack, parrying effects will not prevent Zaahen from gaining the heal. Otherwise, parrying effects will negate all other aspects of The Darkin Glaive's attacks while consuming them.
The ability will not heal against wards, plants, or structures.
Upon being put in resurrection and if The Darkin Glaive is active, it is placed on cooldown immediately.
The first cast's double-strike attack:
Rolls critical strike once for both strikes.
Does not cause Zaahen to attack twice.
Effects that trigger on-attack or interact with the attack windup will only trigger once and thus do not interact with The Darkin Glaive. (e.g. Lethal Tempo, Hail of Blades).
Will consume Bone Plating once.(bug)
If the first strike triggers the rune, the second one will get blocked by it.
If the first strike is blocked by the rune, the second one will not.
The 1.5-second delay is not "fuzzy" (it will never take up to another 0.25 seconds) and so will never correctly sync up with Sheen like Camille's Precision Protocol.(unexpected)
Tips & Tricks
Due to the critical strike rolling behavior affecting both of The Darkin Glaive's first cast's attacks with the same outcome, Sundered Sky may synergize greatly with its effect when ready.

Trivia[edit | edit source]
Zaahen, the Unsundered
Zaahen is one of 23 champions without a single ability power ratio on any ability, the others are: Aatrox, Ambessa, Camille, Darius, Dr. Mundo, Draven, Garen, K'Sante, Kayn, Kled, Naafiri, Nilah, Olaf, Pyke, Riven, Samira, Sett, Talon, Urgot, Xayah, Yone, and Zed.
Cultivation of War directly references Yunara's Cultivation of Spirit.
Zaahen's kit features several homages to Xin Zhao's, his host body.[2]
The Determination portion of his passive, Cultivation of War shares its name with Xin Zhao's Determination.
The Darkin Glaive is an empowered basic attack that knocks targets up, similar to Three Talon Strike.
Dreaded Return is a thrusting ability reminiscent of Wind Becomes Lightning.
Cultivation of War's buff tooltip reads "Knowing your passive is stacking fills you with Determination.", which references and serves as an homage to the 2015 videogame Undertale, in which the specific phrase "…fills you with determination" is stated often by the narrator throughout the game; the phrase has achieved meme status.
Phreak also used the phrase "filled with Determination" in the official Zaahen champion spotlight.
Cultivation of War is similar to Aatrox's old ability Blood Well, both abilities granting stat increases once their respective resource bars are filled, and resurrecting the user if they would take lethal damage.
After his relaunch in patch V8.13, Aatrox would retain a form of resurrection in his World Ender ability, from which it would be inevitably removed in patch V9.14.
The Seneschal Seal icon from Trials of Twilight: Act 1 foreshadowed his silhouette during Grim Deliverance.
